name: EPIC 206002338
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 11.8 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206002338 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.763821 (16th-84th percentiles 11.227947-12.381182), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,276 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.96 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,624 K at its surface.
